response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced full-stack/backend software developer with a strong background in web technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, DLang, MongoDB), but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation platforms. His only C++ experience is nearly a decade old (2014-2015 at National Instruments) and brief, with no evidence of message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443, industrial protocols, or IoT/automation domain work. He is overqualified in general software craftsmanship but critically underqualified in the specific technical and domain competencies required.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (less than 1 year, ending in 2015)
No evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443, MQTT, or relevant protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No demonstrated background in message brokers, embedded/industrial IoT systems, or secure development lifecycle practices

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
